actual_source_semantics.description: EXP2: direct Port10000 packets; v2 preserves same-frame controller-reported joint_position plus joint_actual_position and host receive timestamps; host timing is not controller acquisition time; observations retain visualization-selected actual, command, torque and execution evidence

coverage.time_alignment: LINEAR INTERPOLATION OF EACH RECORDED ACTUAL JOINT STREAM TO A COMMON UNION RECEIVE-TIME TIMELINE — ANALYSIS ONLY

interpolation_policy.method: linear joints on union host receive times; no extrapolation

input_provenance.semantic: ANALYSIS ONLY — ENCODER+URDF MODEL BASED — NOT EXTERNAL METROLOGY — NOT PHASE6 TIMING, FAULT, OR SAFETY AUTHORITY

interpolation_policy.method: linear joints on union host receive times; no extrapolation

coverage.time_alignment: UNION PLANNED PHASE; bounded linear actual-joint interpolation; no host-time pairing

left.monotonicity: accepted phases strictly increasing; sequence violations rejected

right.monotonicity: accepted phases strictly increasing; sequence violations rejected

phase_synchronized.phase_semantic: planned phase inferred from same-frame controller-reported joint_position; not physical cross-arm simultaneity

policy.initial_anchor: first accepted packet is projected only within the first 0.5 planned seconds; this prevents repeated end-pose jumps without forcing phase zero
policy.interpolation: linear actual joints on union matched phases; no extrapolation; duplicate phases retain first packet
policy.limitation: local continuity assumption; missing start, long gaps, dwell and retraced paths may be unavailable or partial
policy.method: joint-space segment projection, unwrapped recorded radians; no host-time matching
policy.ordering: recorded per-side packet order; reject non-increasing sequence indices
policy.progression: nondecreasing phase within 0.5 planned seconds of last match; distant branches excluded; indistinguishable local phases rejected

phase_synchronized.semantic: ANALYSIS ONLY — ENCODER+URDF MODEL BASED — NOT EXTERNAL METROLOGY — NOT PHASE6 TIMING, FAULT, OR SAFETY AUTHORITY

same_packet_tracking.semantic: actual - controller-reported same-frame joint_position; not necessarily original Phase5 command tracking; not external metrology

semantic: ANALYSIS ONLY — ENCODER+URDF MODEL BASED — NOT EXTERNAL METROLOGY — NOT PHASE6 TIMING, FAULT, OR SAFETY AUTHORITY
timestamp_uncertainty: Host receive times are asynchronous and include unknown transport/scheduling delay; they are not controller acquisition times. Bounded interpolation does not remove this uncertainty.
